name: Innovation
overview: Scripture reveals that true innovation originates from God, who created all things from the beginning, bringing forth life and order in creation (Genesis 1:1, 20). Believers are called not to conform to worldly patterns but to be transformed through the renewal of their minds, discerning God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). However, innovation must be rooted in the unchanging gospel and divine truth, avoiding any departure from the original message of salvation (Galatians 1:8). The metaphor of new cloth on old garments (Mark 2:21) cautions against mixing the new with the old in ways that damage what is established, reminding us that spiritual renewal must align with God's revealed Word, which serves as a guiding light for our paths (Psalms 119:105).
